changelog:
* **fix: center the dashboard total card content** (85d8957)
  - Fill the full card width on the amount-in-words line so its
    center alignment takes effect under the grand total.
  - Balance the vertical padding around the words line.
* **fix: polish the author easter egg dialog** (c70db47)
  - Give the dialog a consistent, fixed-size card with balanced padding.
  - Tile each emoji in a rounded box so they render uniformly.
  - Even out the vertical rhythm between title, message and buttons.
  - Make Open and Close matched buttons of the same style.
* **fix: compact the denomination picker sheet** (c34fc3a)
  - Balance sheet padding: breathing room on top, less dead space
    below the OK button.
  - Tighten section gaps from 20/24dp down to 16dp.
  - Hide the row preview line until a count is selected.
  - Show the grand total preview in words under the number.
* **docs: tidy README badge row spacing and order** (d7ba541)
  - Merge the social badges into the main badge paragraph to remove
    the blank gap above Visitors, Stars, Forks and Contributors.
  - Move the Open Source, License and Issues badges to third place,
    right after Latest release and Build status.
* **fix: center compact header titles consistently** (efbb755)
  - Place the title in a fixed-height bar so its position never drifts
    across languages, fonts, or title lengths.
  - Keep the title on one line so the header height stays constant.
  - Preserve the existing style, size, colors, and 16dp side padding.
* **fix: tidy up onboarding wizard layout** (143ada5)
  - Give AnimatedContent fixed bounds so pages never overlap mid-transition.
  - Move scrolling into per-page containers with their own scrollbars.
  - Center the Done page content in the available space.
  - Reserve a fixed trailing slot in option cards to keep titles aligned.
